# <code-block>

Code block with syntax highlighting, copy button, line numbers and themes. A separate package, @profpowell/code-block, not part of the Vanilla Breeze bundle: load it yourself. For plain code, native <pre><code> is already styled. Docs: https://profpowell.github.io/code-block/

- Web component from a separate package. Not in the Vanilla Breeze bundle; load its own script.
- Vanilla Breeze 0.7.4

## Attributes

| Attribute | Values | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `language` | string |  |  |
| `show-lines` | boolean |  |  |
| `label` | string |  |  |
